feeds.title: League of Canadian Poets Blog
feeds.description: The League of Canadian Poets is a national non-profit organization dedicated to supporting poets, building poetic communities, supporting inclusive and equitable free expression, and promoting Canadian poets and Poetry.

feeds.title: EVENT Poetry & Prose Magazine
feeds.description: For 50 years, EVENT has published the very best in contemporary new poetry and prose. We are one of Western Canada's longest-running literary magazines. Each issue of EVENT includes high-quality fiction, poetry, non-fiction, and book reviews, and we feature emerging and established writers side-by-side in our pages.

feeds.title: Derek Beaulieu's Blog
feeds.description: Derek Beaulieu's work is consistently praised as some of the most radical and challenging in contemporary Canadian writing. He is the Director of Literary Arts at Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity. You can read some of the best pieces on his blog.

feeds.title: Another Porch... A Poetry Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Jane Martin. I'm a mother, wife, gramma, homemaker, day-care provider. My inspiration for poetry is rooted in faith and family, in love and nature. I fell in love with poetry as soon as I could read but in the past few years, I have dedicated more time to writing since my kids are older. I am a traditionalist for the most part but have grown to appreciate many styles.

feeds.title: Pearl Pirie Blog
feeds.description: Pirie is a promising writer, giving you her best collections of poems & prose. She is a published poet with over 100 copies sold for a 2020 collection, Called 'Footlight'. Her poems have been given the nod for Best Canadian Poetry in English 3 times.

feeds.title: The Walrus » Poetry
feeds.description: The following section of The Walrus is dedicated to Poems and Literary works. The Walrus provokes new thinking and sparks conversation on matters vital to Canadians. As a registered charity, we publish independent, fact-based journalism, produce national, ideas-focused events, and train emerging professionals in publishing and nonprofit management.

feeds.title: The Miramichi Reader » Poetry
feeds.description: Posts about Poetry written by Catherine Owen. The Miramichi Reader highlights noteworthy books and authors across Canada from coast to coast to coast. We invite you to peruse our site for in-depth Book Reviews, Author Interviews, Literary Criticism and Essays, posted daily.

feeds.title: Wolsak & Wynn Blog
feeds.description: Wolsak and Wynn was created in 1982 by two dedicated poets, Heather Cadsby and Marja Jacobs, who felt that important poetry was being neglected by the publishers of the day. Today this is the umbrella imprint for the press, and it is still the place to find important work that has been overlooked by larger publishers, whether it's cultural analysis, memoir, or translation.

feeds.title: Welcome to Avalon » Poetry
feeds.description: The following section is dedicated to Poems. A steadfast and proud sci-fi and fantasy geek, A. F. Stewart was born and raised in Nova Scotia, Canada, and still calls it home. As an indie author, she's published novels, novellas, and story collections, with a few side trips into poetry.

feeds.title: A Net in Time » Poetry
feeds.description: I am centered on the love of God and family. Smiles are brought about by being a Writer, Poet, Hiker, and reader. Growth occurs as I educate my son, raise him up in the fear of the Lord, love up on my critters, and live as a pastor's wife. The following section of A Net in Time is dedicated to Poetries providing its readers with a whole collection of best-written poems.

feeds.title: At the Brook's Bend Blog
feeds.description: Brooklyn's poetry, non-fiction, and fiction have been published in numerous magazines and newsletters, and her historical fiction has been both placed and shortlisted through writing contests in Canada. You can read all the best work on this blog.

feeds.title: Poetry Undressed Blog
feeds.description: Poetry Undressed is an online publishing company which will focus on showcasing new and up-and-coming poets; those who have struggled to have their voices heard in the elitist society that is that of poetry. Poetry Undressed aims to create an environment where poetry is accessible, enjoyable, and understandable for all.

feeds.title: Visible Poetry
feeds.description: What if we thought of poetry as something visible everywhere? Much of what we call poetry IS blogging of a sort, a lyric voice meandering through the sounds and images and movements of the world, trying on sensations and seeking interlocutors. Visible Poetry: Aesthetic Acts in Progress continues to explore the expanding some horizons of this oldest of forms.

feeds.title: University of Alberta Press » Poetry
feeds.description: The following section of the University of Alberta Press Blog is dedicated to Poetry. University of Alberta Press publishes in the areas of biography, literature, natural history, regional interest, social sciences, travel narratives, and reference books.

feeds.title: My Sister's Keeper » Poetry
feeds.description: Read posts on poetry written by Rae-Anne & Rekeisha in the following section of My Sister's Keeper. We're a blogging sisterhood, full of laughter, love, and fun! Join us on our blogging journey!
